features: Built in Wardrobes in Every Bedroom
Underfloor Heating Included in Service Charge
Great Transport Links Including Elizabeth Line
description_html:
Spectacular panoramic views from this spacious 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment. Located on the 17th floor. Type 8C. Each principal room gives access to a balcony with floor to ceiling windows/doors throughout. A generous built in cupboard on entering the apartment for coats etc. Family bathroom and a separate shower room with W.C. Underfloor heating throughout included in the service charge. 3 lifts.  24 hour concierge. Use of residents gardens. The apartment benefits from an extended lease. Parking by separate negotiation with the City of London. Designed by the renowned architects Chamberlin, Powell & Bon, the Grade II-listed Barbican Estate includes the Barbican Arts Centre, cinema, art gallery, concert hall, restaurants, bars and cafes. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco's are close at hand. is perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon, (which has direct trains to both Heathrow and Gatwick), and Liverpool Street stations only a short walk away, also with close proximity to the various lines at underground stations Barbican, St. Paul’s, and Moorgate. No onward chain. 
Service Charge: 31st March - 1st April 2026/2027 Estimated £11,504 + £1,905 non annually recurring item
